{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_orders = df[refunded_mask]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
missing_age = df[missing_age_mask]
print(f'Number of missing age entries (customer_age = -1): {len(missing_age)}')

# Confirm the clean revenue
print(f'First 5 cleaned revenue values: {df["revenue_clean"].head().tolist()}')"}
